events.evidence: A high-speed train carrying 222 passengers derails near Santiago de Compostela, Spain, leaving 79 dead
Wells Fargo of the United States becomes the world's largest bank by market capitalisation, replacing the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China amid an economic slowdown in China
Clashes between the Knights Templar Cartel and the Mexican federal police leave 22 dead in the state of Michoacán
